lines.x: Brazilian asset managers are reducing exposure to domestic equities and rate-cut bets, shifting portfolios toward cash reserves, US dollars, and defensive stocks due to fiscal policy uncertainties.
Brazilian energy and logistics holding group Cosan posted a net profit of US$34 million for the third quarter, while reducing its expanded net debt by 48% to US$1.7 billion.
Banco ABC Brasil signed a share purchase agreement to acquire a stake in Angá Controle Holding, which consolidates Angá Asset Management.

Speaking in Manila following an Asian diplomatic tour, President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva stated Brazil sought new trade partners in China, Indonesia, and Vietnam rather than mourning US tariff increases.
